meta.name: hyperframes-registry
meta.description: Install, discover, and wire registry blocks and components into HyperFrames compositions. Use when running hyperframes add or hyperframes catalog, installing one item or every block matching a tag, wiring an installed item into index.html, or working with hyperframes.json. Covers discovery, install locations, block sub-composition wiring, component snippet merging, and authoring a new block or component to contribute upstream (idea → scaffold → validate → PR).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 发现、安装并接入页面组件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在用 HyperFrames 搭建页面，想复用现成块或贡献新块。
copy.tagline_en: Discover, install, and wire page components
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build pages with HyperFrames and want to reuse or contribute components.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会运行 hyperframes add/catalog 帮你安装或搜索素材；装完告诉你写入了哪些文件，并给出一段可粘贴的接入片段；也会按步骤把组件代码并入你的合成。
howto.when: 当你想安装或搜索 HyperFrames 素材、把已装素材接入画面、或处理 hyperframes.json 时。

say.text: 帮我搜一下能逐行揭示标题的素材。
把 grain-overlay 组件接进我的画面。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude runs hyperframes add/catalog to install or search blocks/components, reports written files and gives a paste-ready snippet, and walks through merging a component's code into your composition.
howto.when_en: When the user wants to install or search HyperFrames items, wire an installed item into a composition, or work with hyperframes.json.

say_en.note: Runs hyperframes add data-chart and prints wiring hints.

say_en.text: Search for a block that reveals a headline one line at a time.
say_en.note: Runs hyperframes catalog --query against the catalog.

say_en.text: Wire the grain-overlay component into my composition.
say_en.note: Walks through pasting the component's HTML/CSS/JS snippet.
